ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that in circle $\odot O$, CD is the diameter of $\odot O$, and points A and B are on $\odot O$ with $AC=AB$. If $\angle BCD=26^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle ABC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since CD is the diameter,\\
$\therefore\angle CAD=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore\angle ACD+\angle ADC=90^\circ$,\\
Since AC$=$AB,\\
$\therefore\angle ACB=\angle B$,\\
Since $\angle D=\angle B$,\\
$\therefore\angle ACB=\angle D$,\\
$\therefore\angle ACB+26^\circ+\angle D=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore\angle ACB=32^\circ$,\\
$\therefore\angle ABC=\angle ACB=\boxed{32^\circ}$
